subject: What Changed to Your Credit Card Today? Edition 5
summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank pulls the fuel surcharge waiver off three more cards, the NRI Royale Signature, Royale Signature, and Privy League Signature, continuing the sweep that started on 22 August.
body_html:
If you hold a Kotak Mahindra Bank credit card, this is the third day in a row we're writing about the same thing, and that's worth noticing on its own. A single fuel surcharge waiver disappearing is a footnote. Six cards losing it in four days is a pattern, and patterns are worth flagging before you find out the hard way at the pump. Today it's three more Kotak cards: the NRI Royale Signature, the Royale Signature, and the Privy League Signature.

Kotak NRI Royale Signature Credit Card

The fuel surcharge waiver is gone from this card's terms, same as it went from four other Kotak cards on 22 August (Corporate Platinum, Corporate Wealth Signature, Solitaire Business, and Solitaire).

Kotak hasn't republished the exact rupee bracket for this card specifically, but going by the pattern on the cards it already pulled this waiver from, the typical structure was 1% back on fuel transactions in the ₹500 to ₹3,000-5,000 range, capped at roughly ₹3,500 a year. If you were filling up ₹4,000 to ₹5,000 a month on this card, that waiver was worth somewhere around ₹400 to ₹500 a year to you. It's gone now.

The catch: a 1% surcharge on fuel doesn't sound like much when you say it out loud, which is exactly why banks can remove it quietly and count on most cardholders not noticing for months.

Kotak Royale Signature Credit Card

Same removal, same card family. The fuel surcharge waiver fee is gone from the Royale Signature's terms.

Using the same benchmark as above, roughly ₹400 to ₹500 a year in fuel surcharge savings for someone filling up regularly on this card, now off the table.

The catch: if fuel wasn't a big part of your spend on this card, this changes nothing for you. If it was, this is one more reason to check whether Kotak's other benefits on this card still justify keeping it as your primary card.

Kotak Privy League Signature Credit Card

Third card, same story: the fuel surcharge waiver has been removed.

That's now seven Kotak Mahindra Bank cards (four last time, three today) that have lost this specific benefit inside a week. Kotak hasn't put out a statement explaining why, but when the same change hits this many cards from one issuer in such a short window, it usually means a bank-wide policy decision, not a one-off.

The catch: if you hold any other Kotak credit card that still shows a fuel surcharge waiver in its terms today, don't assume it's safe. Check your next statement.

What I'd actually do with this

If you hold the NRI Royale Signature, Royale Signature, or Privy League Signature card and you fuel up regularly on it, that specific saving is gone starting now, so factor it out of your mental math on what this card earns you. None of these changes affect your annual fee, your reward rate on other spends, or your lounge access, so this alone isn't a reason to close the card.

But if you hold any other Kotak credit card, spend some time this week checking whether your card still lists a fuel surcharge waiver. Given how many Kotak cards have lost this in the last few days, the safer assumption right now is that it's being phased out bank-wide, not card by card.

This is my honest read, not formal financial advice. I'm not your advisor, and before you make a call on switching cards over a benefit this small, run the full picture past a professional or at least sleep on it. But this is exactly how I'd think about it if it were my card.

Monzy
